entities.summary: Mooji is a Jamaican spiritual teacher of Advaita based in the UK and Portugal. He gives talks (satsang) and conducts retreats. Mooji lives in Portugal, at Monte Sahaja. Mooji was a writers & intellectuals from Port Antonio (b. 1954-01-29, Port Antonio). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
